additional_info.subject: RE: ID0438936/DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/S7314182274002]RFID refused - unknown error CRM:02681000507
additional_info.body:
Dear Luigi Iodice,
Greetings of the day!
We have checked the logs and noticed that the RFID ID tag you used is showing a "Blocked" status during the authorization attempt. This means the tag is currently not whitelisted or authorized on the charger or backend system.
To resolve this issue, we recommend the following steps:
Ensure the RFID tag is added to the whitelist on your Charge Point Operator (CPO) or backend system.
Once the tag is successfully added and synced with the charger, it should authorize correctly even in offline scenarios.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
